newsitem.title: UK: Further room for Russia debt prices to rise - DMG.
newsitem.headline: Further room for Russia debt prices to rise - DMG.

text.p: There is ample room for Russian debt prices to rise further following the latest surge on the back of a positive credit rating, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell analyst Stuart Parkinson said on Wendesday.
An expected Russian Eurobond, with speculation of a spread of 350 basis points over three years, suggests an upside for MinFin three bonds of four points and seven points for the MinFin fours.
"Although a 350 bps Eurobond spread sounds tight in relation to market gossip as little as a month ago, we cannot discount the possibility of an even tighter spread," he said in a research paper.
The when and if loans, which the Vneshekonombank debt is likely to turn into later this year, could rise another 11 points on convergence with yield curves for Mexican and Argentine debt.
Vnesh debt itself could see even higher returns, with Swiss franc paper possibly jumping over 20 points once the debt restructuring deal is completed.
